name: Protein Coffee Iced Vanilla Latte
caffeineNote: Brand panel states 160 mg; the Double Espresso in the same line is 240 mg
summary: Australian protein coffee in a can: brewed coffee over whole and ultra-filtered skim milk powders, so the 15.2 g of protein comes from the milk rather than an added isolate. The brand's panel gives 160 mg of caffeine, 166 calories and 12.8 g of sugar; it states no can size, and no added-sugars line, since Australian panels do not carry one.
